run_sliding_sum: run sliding_sum to compute a sliding window sum over a numpy array with start/end bounds and min_periods
run_grouped_sum: run grouped_sum to compute a grouped sum over values labeled by group indices with min_periods and skipna
run_add_sum: run add_sum to perform a Kahan-compensated single-value addition to a running sum with observation counting
run_remove_sum: run remove_sum to perform a Kahan-compensated single-value removal from a running sum
run_grouped_kahan_sum: run grouped_kahan_sum to compute Kahan-compensated sums grouped by integer labels with skipna support
